prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Added a localized credit history section under the credit balance on the Settings page displaying when each transaction occurred, what it was for, and the credit amount, with refunds marked as refunds in both English and Korean.

check.why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog

+import base64

+def _get_credits(client, headers) -> int:
+    workspaces = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()
+    return workspaces[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def _get_transactions(workspace_id):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        return list(
+            session.exec(
+                select(CreditTransaction)
+                .where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id)
+                .order_by(CreditTransaction.timestamp.desc())
+            ).all()
+        )
+
+
+def _create_project_and_character(client, headers):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Starlight", "genre_ids": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    project = r.json()
+
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "name": "Aria",
+            "project_id": project["id"],
+            "appearance_tags": ["silver hair"],
+            "default_mood": ["calm"],
+            "description": "A star navigator",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    character = r.json()
+    return project, character
+
+
+def test_failed_project_cover_does_not_charge_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project, _ = _create_project_and_character(client, h)
+    before = _get_credits(client, h)
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    proj_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert proj_detail["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == before
+    txs = _get_transactions(project["workspace_id"])
+    assert [t.amount for t in txs] == [15, -15]
+
+    # When AI succeeds, 15 credits are charged
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    proj_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert proj_detail["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert _get_credits(client, h) == before - 15
+
+
